column1: # 26장 말투 지시(11-10). 열: 조각 앞머리 → 지시(영어, 짧게). @scene 행은 장면 설명. 호수 장면은 비교판 S4 때 쓴 것, 나머지 장면은 뒤에 채움.
@scene 화요일 저녁 일곱 시, 나는 다시
column2: Tuesday evening in the basement of the old workshop. Marc, the reserved locksmith, has finished restoring his grandfather Martí's clock; it is ready, stopped at twelve. Yuna has the key to wind it, but Marc suggests waiting eight days for November 11, Sant Martí, his grandfather's saint's day, so Montse, Vale and Joan can be there. Then, switching off the lamp, he asks Yuna on a date ("una cita"). Shy, warm, a little playful.

column2: low and simple, a gift; "Para ti" softly

column2: Sunday morning in Yuna's room. She changes clothes three times while Vale, the young Argentine lodger, sits on her bed with her mate and judges each outfit, insisting green makes Yuna's eyes shine and that this is "science", then "Argentine science". Light, teasing, friendly.

column1: 일요일, 나는 옷을 세 번 갈아입었다

column2: quick verdicts, then pleased; Rioplatense, "te ponés" with the stress on the end

The date: Yuna meets Marc at the Arc de Triomf and they walk into the Ciutadella park on a busy Sunday. Marc, usually dry and brief, makes small jokes: the green parrots came from Argentina and are noisy, like Vale; if the fountain were by Gaudí, they would have to pay. Yuna laughs a lot. Easy, sunny, a first date.
simple and kind, holding out the coffee
explaining, a little proud of his city

Autumn, a rowing boat in the middle of the park lake. Marc, a reserved locksmith of few words, finally tells Yuna two things: he nearly sold his grandfather's workshop, and he likes her. Yuna answers in Spanish without searching for words. Quiet and intimate, no drama.
a plain confession, looking at the water
slow and careful, holding back emotion; "Eso es todo" plain and short
softly and sure, a quiet smile

column2: The rest of the day after the kiss. Yuna has not answered Marc's real question: will she stay in Barcelona? That night she writes "si" in her notebook and thinks about the grammar: "si te quedas" (possible), "si te quedaras" (further away), and Marc's mix "si te quedas, me harías", wrong in an exam but in the lake it was fear. Quiet, reflective, happy but unsure.

column1: No le contesté lo más importante.
Por la noche, en mi habitación
Esa noche no supe qué iba a hacer.
